title: Hurricane Harvey Relief
description: U.S. Air Force pararescuemen from the 106th Rescue Wing, New York Air National Guard, perform search and rescue missions from a HH-60 Pave Hawk near Houston, Texas after Hurricane Harvey. The relief efforts have a conglomerate of active, guard, and reserve units from all branches supporting the federal government to help Texas recover from the storm. (U.S. Air Force Video by SrA Joshua Hoskins)
keywords: PJ, pararescue, ANG, HH-60, Pave Hawk, Harvey, 106th, Hurricane Harvey, Texas, New York, Hurricane
editor_note: Strong (children on screen) but held as new: flood hoists published Nov 3-4. Use after Nov 7, one at a time.
pass_reason: Good footage (106th RQW PJs, little girl carried in cabin, kids aboard) but flood hoist type published Nov 2, 3 and 4 and Harvey is overdone; release gives no specific rescue or outcome. Revisit after Nov 8.
